rulebook.title: FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2024 and FIBA Basketball Equipment (OBR 2026 takes effect on 1 October 2026: free line colours, visible-sock rule removed, unsportsmanlike foul renamed; article numbers may move)
rulebook.text_used: search extracts of FIBA pages, FIBA Tough Calls articles and federation copies (fiba.basketball was not reachable for direct reading)

court_m.note: to the inner edge of the boundary lines; NBA 28.65 x 15.24

line_width_m.note: white under OBR 2024; OBR 2026 allows other colours

ball.note: size 7 men, size 6 women; sizes confirmed from secondary sources

equipment.rule: Equipment (3.05 m to the top of the ring)

scene.text: Five players per team on the court.

Home team in light (preferably white) shirts, visiting team in dark shirts; shirts tucked into the shorts; all sleeves, headbands, wristbands and tape on a team in the same solid colour, headbands at most 10 cm wide.
Shirt numbers only 0, 00 or 1-99: at least 20 cm tall on the back and 10 cm on the front.
A crew chief and one or two umpires in grey officials' shirts on the court; scorer, timer and shot-clock operator at the table.
Shot clocks mounted above and behind each backboard (red digits); backboard 1.80 x 1.05 m with its lower edge 2.90 m up, 1.20 m in from the endline; ring 3.05 m high with a 40-45 cm net.
Court 28 x 15 m with 5 cm lines, three-point arc 6.75 m (6.60 m in the corners), free-throw line 5.80 m from the endline, no-charge semi-circle 1.25 m under the basket.

fouls.title: Legal guarding position
fouls.text: A defender has a legal guarding position when facing the opponent with both feet on the floor; the position extends vertically (cylinder), and the defender may move sideways or backwards to keep it.
fouls.legal: the defender faces the ball handler with both feet on the floor (legal guarding position)
avoid: defender with one foot off the floor

fouls.title: Cylinder and verticality
fouls.text: Each player owns the vertical space above their position; a player who leaves their cylinder and makes contact is responsible for it.
fouls.legal: no body contact with an opponent outside the player's own cylinder

fouls.title: Travelling on a shot
fouls.text: A player may jump off the pivot foot to shoot, but the ball must be released before either foot returns to the floor.
fouls.legal: the ball has left the hands while both feet are still in the air
avoid: shooter landing while still holding the ball

fouls.title: Steps on a layup
fouls.text: After gaining control while moving, a player may take two steps (a gather step with a foot already on the floor does not count) before passing or shooting.
fouls.legal: the ball is gathered in both hands and the player takes off from the second step (left foot)

fouls.title: Landing space
fouls.text: A player who has jumped has the right to land at the same place (or at a spot not occupied by an opponent at take-off).

fouls.title: Hanging on the ring
fouls.text: Hanging so that the ring supports the player's weight is a technical foul; after a dunk the ring may be grasped only momentarily, or to prevent injury.
fouls.legal: the hand pushes the ball down through the ring and grasps the ring at most momentarily
avoid: player hanging from the ring with full body weight

fouls.title: Goaltending and basket interference
fouls.text: Touching a shot on its downward flight completely above the ring, or touching the ring or backboard while the ball is on the ring, is a violation.
fouls.legal: no other player touches the ball on its downward flight above the ring

fouls.title: Uniform
fouls.text: Shirts tucked in; sleeves, headbands, wristbands and tape of one solid team colour.
